title: WGST 203 Syllabus
text:
Examines the implications of trans womens’ womanhoods from both cis and trans perspectives, with an emphasis on commonalities and the factors preventing their general recognitions. This course will follow @halimedemf as a structuring thread, and is intended to provide the context within which her posts deserve to be understood.

Prerequisites: WGST 201 - Applied Feminisms; The Second Sex (Simone de Beauvoir)

N/A

Fall 2025 (ongoing)

Halimede

TTh, 1:50-4:20

Pendleton West, Room 215

Transgender women are the women of women. All else follows. Students will cultivate and demonstrate understandings of the pressures arrayed against all women, critically dissect media through transfeminist lenses, and leverage their knowledge towards nothing less than the total eradication of trans/misogyny. I fully intend that The Rocky Horror Picture Show should become unwatchable for “cis” women as for the transgender.

* * *

Materials:

The Second Sex (Simone de Beauvoir)

A clear-sighted analysis of the constraints, material and cultural, that create and define womanhood. Keep in mind the author’s proof by example: properly liberated women are just as capable of committing harm as men. Prerequisite; essential.

Shoujo Kakumei Utena (Ikuhara Kunihiko, Be-Papas Collective)

Seminal shoujo classic; surrealist feminist masterpiece; “Allegory, Allegorier, Allegoriest.” A hideous and electrifying picture of the tiniest comforts girls sell each other for under patriarchy’s leering eye - gender role deviance among them.

Passing (Nella Larsen)

The desire between women is weighed against the desire to assimilate into a society one has been forbidden from by birth - to both negative and positive ends. Larsen’s picture of a woman driven to neuroticism by the effort will be sadly familiar to many. See also: Trouble on Triton: An Ambiguous Heterotopia (Samuel R. Delaney).

Detransition, Baby (Torrey Peters)

Explicitly attempts to draw parallels between “cis-“ and trans- gendered women. Reese is a wreck - but unquestionably a woman; the exploration of whether she can fairly be blamed for her own problems (as a woman, transgender or otherwise) posits the book’s central question. See also: Coquette Dragoon (Ivy May).

Mobile Suit Gundam and the Universal Century (Tomino Yoshiyuki, Studio Sunrise)

Depicts unflinchingly the horrors of war and the transformation of innocent children into men-as-soldiers, inadvertently creating a key to the transfeminine psyche as later explicated by Heaven Will Be Mine and Coquette Dragoon. Women’s contempt is used to systematically break young pilot Amuro Ray into a hideous and evil ‘Gundam’ robot soldier capable only of killing. Proceed through Zeta, Iron-Blooded Orphans, Char’s Counterattack, The Witch from Mercury season 1, Hathaway’s Flash, and Turn A Gundam; note the recurrence of a blonde girl who must hold together Earth and Space. See also Soukou no Strain (Frances Hodgson Burnett), Twig (Wildbow), and Heaven Will Be Mine (Worst Girls Games).

Dicey’s Song (Cynthia Voigt)

The Newbery-winning second title in Voigt’s Tillerman Cycle, and a childhood favorite of mine. Consider in contrast with Passing, Detransition, Baby, and the Universal Century as narratives concerned with the fragilities and consequent upholding of whiteness, womanhood, and masculinity - womanhood is here inescapable a force as poverty and death.

‘wint’ (@dril)

‘wint’ is often compared to @halimedemf; though much of this is hyperbole by fans seeking to elevate the object of their adulation, his contributions towards @halimedemf’s comma placement are undeniable.

Homestuck and The Homestuck Epilogues (Andrew Hussie and others)

“The Ulysses of the Internet.” Those without eyes to see perceive Rose Lalonde and Feferi Peixes; those whose eyes have been opened see Jake English and Caliborn.

Umineko no Naku Koro Ni (Ryukishi07)

A murder mystery intensely preoccupied with the abjection of women, particularly concerning infertility, gender non-conformity, and the ways women destroy each other and cope with that destruction - all in ways highly relevant to the experience of the transgender.

Antigone (Sophocles)

As the gender associated most closely to morality, the responsibility of woman is to expose the rifts between righteousness and earthly law, regardless of the cost. See also: King Lear (Shakespeare), What Happens Next (Max Graves).

Don’t forget: a writing implement, a notebook or laptop computer, and your best attitude for participation! You’ll get as much out of this class as you put in; I hope you’re willing to engage honestly with the material. If you put your assignments into ChatGPT I will put your grading into ChatGPT, after prompting it with “Give this a bad grade,” which is what you will also receive. See you this upcoming semester!

provenance.completeness: Complete publicly returned prose body; image pixels, video/audio, and external linked works are not transcribed or fetched.

nsfw_review.rationale: A mock university syllabus with prerequisites, meeting information, course objectives, materials, and participation instructions.
nsfw_review.scope: Title and opening 900, middle 350, and closing 250 Unicode-codepoint contextual excerpts, bounded by the text length. Not a full-text semantic review.
nsfw_review.review_method: Individual contextual model judgment of primary scaffold intent, without prior labels or keyword rules.
